```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  select(artist, track, date.entered, wk1:wk4)
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = wk6)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Week 6 Rankings",
    subtitle = "Number of songs: 280",
    x = "Week 6 Rank",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  select(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(), 
    names_to = "week", 
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |> 
  group_by(week) |> 
  summarize(
    present = sum(!is.na(rank)),
    missing = sum(is.na(rank))
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"), 
    names_to = "week", 
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  scale_y_reverse()
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"), 
    names_to = "week", 
    values_to = "rank", 
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |> 
  group_by(artist, track) |> 
  summarize(
    re_entered = any(diff(week) > 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  count(re_entered)
```

```{r}
billboard_summary <- billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"), 
    names_to = "week", 
    values_to = "rank", 
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |> 
  group_by(artist, track) |> 
  summarize(
    first_rank = rank[which.min(week)],
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    total_weeks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

billboard_summary

# Fastest song to reach #1
billboard_summary |> 
  filter(best_rank == 1) |> 
  slice_min(first_week_at_best, n = 1)

# Slowest song to reach #1
billboard_summary |> 
  filter(best_rank == 1) |> 
  slice_max(first_week_at_best, n = 1)

# Top-10 song with longest chart run
billboard_summary |> 
  filter(best_rank <= 10) |> 
  slice_max(total_weeks, n = 1)
```

```{r}
top10_long <- billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"), 
    names_to = "week", 
    values_to = "rank", 
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |> 
  group_by(artist, track) |> 
  filter(min(rank) <= 10) |> 
  ungroup()

notable_songs <- top10_long |> 
  filter(track %in% c("Music", "Amazed", "Higher"))

peak_points <- notable_songs |> 
  group_by(track) |> 
  slice_min(rank, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = top10_long, 
    aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track), 
    color = "gray80", 
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = notable_songs, 
    aes(x = week, y = rank, color = track), 
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = peak_points,
    aes(x = week, y = rank, color = track),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = peak_points,
    aes(x = week, y = rank, label = paste0(track, " (Peak: #", rank, ")")),
    vjust = -1,
    size = 3.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Top 10 Songs in 2000",
    subtitle = "Highlighting fastest to #1, slowest to #1, and longest chart run",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Rank",
    color = "Song"
  )
```
